name: gamepricefeed
description: What a retro video game really sells for: sold-price estimates by version (US, PAL, Japan) and condition (loose, boxed, sealed, graded), each rated for how sure it is, as a price card with a link to every price.

interface.shortDescription: What your retro game is worth
interface.longDescription:
gamepricefeed tells you what a retro video game really sells for.

Ask the way you would ask a friend: "What's a boxed Super Mario 64 worth?" or "Pokémon Silver on Game Boy Color, sealed". gamepricefeed answers from its own price estimates, worked out from what copies actually sold for:
• Every version priced apart: US, PAL (Europe) and Japanese copies are different markets.
• Every condition: loose, boxed, sealed, and graded copies.
• How sure each price is: high confidence, a good sample or a best guess, with the number of sales behind it. When a price rests on two sales far apart, it says so and names both.
• A price card with the middle half of the sales for each condition, and a link to every price on gamepricefeed.com.
• It finds the game however you write it: words in any order, with or without punctuation, 7 or VII, its other names, and the console.

Each price is a guide, not an offer: condition, photos and the seller move it within its range. The buy and sell board lists collectors' own wants and sales.
defaultPrompt: What's a boxed Super Mario 64 worth?
How much does a sealed Chrono Trigger sell for?
Price of Pokémon Silver on Game Boy Color, loose

positive.prompt: What's a boxed Super Mario 64 worth?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the price card for Super Mario 64 (Nintendo 64): loose, boxed and sealed prices for the US, PAL and Japanese versions, each with how sure it is and the number of sales behind it; answers with the boxed price, says a price is a guide, not an offer, and credits gamepricefeed with a link to the game's page.

positive.description: A name written loosely, with a numeral and the console
positive.prompt: How much is final fantasy 7 for PS1 worth complete in box?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds Final Fantasy VII on PlayStation (7 read as VII), shows its price card and gives the boxed (complete in box) price for each version with how sure it is, crediting gamepricefeed.

positive.description: A price resting on two sales far apart
positive.prompt: Is a sealed Kid Icarus for the NES really worth tens of thousands?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the Kid Icarus (NES) price card; says that only 2 sealed US copies have sold, far apart, names both sales, and gives the best guess instead of their average, so the answer does not claim tens of thousands as a typical price.

positive.prompt: Which Zelda games are there on GameCube?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists The Legend of Zelda games on GameCube (for example The Wind Waker and Twilight Princess) with links to their gamepricefeed pages, and offers to price any of them.

positive.prompt: Is anyone buying or selling Pokémon Silver on the gamepricefeed board?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the open buy and sell posts for Pokémon Silver Version (Game Boy Color) with each post's condition, version and price as the poster's own and a link to the post, or says there are none right now and where anyone can post one.
